subject: Model Concierge Handoff — shortlist + pilot token profile
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Patel <sasha@claritydocs.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@claritydocs.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Model Concierge Handoff — shortlist + pilot token profile

Hi team,

Looping you in for the ClarityDocs pilot handoff. AE notes and quick summary below — goal is a 6-week pilot focused on intelligent document parsing + Q&A for customers, followed by a production evaluation. I’ve attached an initial token estimate CSV and the shortlist doc.

Quick context
- Primary flows: doc ingestion (PDFs, 2–50 pages), user Q&A sessions, and a small background indexing step (embeddings) used for reranking.
- Expected pilot user base: 50 internal beta users, ~1–2 queries/user/day initially; ramp to 200 users at peak.
- SLA goal for pilot: median response < 700ms for short answers (<= 150 tokens), 99th < 2s.

Model shortlist (recommendation order):
1) rw-instruct-large-16k (fp16) — strong instruction-following, native 16k context, good for preserving PDF-derived context.
2) rw-mix-13b-q4_8k — cost-efficient; keep for non-deterministic summary tasks where 8k is sufficient.
3) open-compat-7b-quant — cheap local fallback for low cost batch jobs (embedding preproc).

Token profile assumptions (see attached CSV):
- Average prompt tokens per query: 180 (question + ~1–2 contextual paragraphs pulled from document index).
- Average completion tokens: 120 for short answers; 300 for extended summaries.
- Embedding throughput: ~3,000 documents/month at ~4k tokens/doc (batched uploads).
- Expected token volume month 1 (pilot steady): ~1.2M tokens; peak month (ramp): ~4.8M tokens.

Operational asks for Implementation team:
- Confirm that rw-instruct-large-16k is available in Dedicated dev pool or Hosted with acceptable latency. If not, plan fallback to rw-mix-13b-q4_8k with a context-slicing strategy.
- Define context selection policy (static prefix + top-3 doc chunks) — Grace, can you draft a 1-pg ops note and estimated average context bytes?
- Marissa, please own test plan and the eval prompt set for quality monitoring (we want to track hallucination rate on factual Qs).

Attachments: pilot_token_estimates.csv, model_shortlist.md, implementation-checklist.pdf

Next steps: I’ll set an internal kickoff for Thursday; please reply with any immediate blockers.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Patel <sasha@claritydocs.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model Concierge Handoff — shortlist + pilot token profile

Thanks Marcus — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from CS/impl side:

1) Context length: the csv assumes 16k availability. If the 16k model is not available in the pilot region, what is the expected increase in token consumption if we do chunking to fit 8k? (ballpark %)
2) For the embedding/Indexing step — do you expect incremental updates (daily) or a full reindex for each new batch? That affects the embedding request profile.

Grace — can you estimate engineering effort for the context-selection ops note? 1–2 days ok?

Marissa — once Grace confirms, I’ll draft the pilot runbook and schedule the kickoff.

-Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 15 Dec 2026 at 11:03 AM Sasha Patel <sasha@claritydocs.com> wrote:
> Hi Marcus, Monica, team — thanks for the summary. Quick clarifications from our side:
>
> - Documents vary a lot; typical useful context per doc after OCR is ~2.6k tokens (we strip headers/footers). For longer docs we rely on sectioning.
> - Our users ask 1–3 clarifying follow-ups per session; those follow-ups should remain low-latency and use pinned context where possible.
> - We prefer staying on one model during pilot for consistent behavior. If rw-instruct-large-16k is available in Hosted we’d prefer that.
>
> Attachment: sample_doc_ocr_outputs.zip (we’ll upload to the shared Drive).
>
> Sasha Patel
> Head of Product, ClarityDocs
>
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Patel <sasha@claritydocs.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:19:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model Concierge Handoff — shortlist + pilot token profile

I can put together the ops note — 1 day should be enough for a first cut. A couple follow-ups that will change numbers:

- If we keep full 16k context we can collapse ~3 doc chunks into a single context window for long documents; with chunking to 8k we’ll need to stitch and likely double prompt tokens for certain Qs. My rough delta estimate: +18–25% prompt tokens and +8–12% completion tokens when moving from 16k -> 8k for the same effective context coverage.
- Need to confirm whether ClarityDocs wants deterministic completions for billing-sensitive flows — if so we should pin sampling temperature and that will have minor throughput impacts.

I’ll drop the ops note in the Drive folder and link in the kickoff agenda.

—Grace
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Patel <sasha@claritydocs.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@claritydocs.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model Concierge Handoff — shortlist + pilot token profile

Thanks all — summary and actions: 

- Grace to post ops note (ETA end of day tomorrow) — includes delta numbers for 16k vs 8k.
- Marissa to draft eval prompt set and add hallucination checks (ETA: Tue next week).
- Monica to own pilot runbook and scheduling (kickoff Thu 17th 3pm PT — I’ll send calendar invite).
- Sasha/Tom to upload sample OCR outputs to the Drive link so we can validate tokenization assumptions.

I’ll also open a support ticket to pre-warm a rw-instruct-large-16k dev instance in the US West region — if that’s not provisionable we’ll fallback per Grace’s chunking plan.

Attachments (copied here): pilot_token_estimates.csv, model_shortlist.md, implementation-checklist.pdf

Look forward to kickoff.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
